parts.name: What this language plugin reads
parts.hint: Which files does aidea understand now?
parts.what: One or two plain sentences saying which language the plugin reads and what it draws on the Components layer today (for example: each file as a module).
parts.question: What would you expect to see on the Components layer for a project in this language?
parts.example: One concrete example: a project with two files shows two modules.
parts.narration: Let's look at what aidea can now read.
parts.tryIt: Open a project that has files in this language and look at the Components layer.
